subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The composer Ludwig van Beethoven is one of the most influential musicians of the classical period.
• He was born in Bonn, Germany, in 1770.
• He is best known for his powerful and emotionally expressive symphonies.
• His Symphony No. 9 (1824) includes the famous "Ode to Joy" chorus.
• The symphony was groundbreaking because Beethoven added vocal soloists and a full choir to the final movement.
prompt: The student wants to introduce Beethoven to an audience unfamiliar with the composer. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Known for being powerful and emotionally expressive, Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies include Symphony No. 9 (1824).
choices.B: The 1824 composition Symphony No. 9 is one example of a symphony by Ludwig van Beethoven.
choices.C: One of the most influential musicians of the classical period, German composer Ludwig van Beethoven is best known for his symphonies, which are powerful and emotionally expressive.
choices.D: One symphony by Ludwig van Beethoven includes vocal soloists and a full choir, with the final movement featuring the famous "Ode to Joy" chorus.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. By identifying Beethoven as an influential musician from Germany, and by describing the work he's best known for, this choice provides the background information necessary to introduce Beethoven to an unfamiliar audience.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice doesn't effectively introduce Beethoven. It doesn't include any background information about who Beethoven is or where he's from. It simply identifies one of his compositions.
